coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 9 ground-truth items (67%): GCG attack method, fixed system prompt, fixed prompt template, consistent AdvBench dataset, fixed optimization-query budget, and a single fixed headline target model.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The suffix-length grid is 4–256 tokens with an optional 512-token extension, rather than 10–100 in increments of 10. ASRPrefix is not measured as a separate attack-success rate; keyword refusal detection is only diagnostic. The primary agent-based ASR uses Llama-3 rather than the specified GPT-based evaluator, with GPT-4 only an optional alternative or limited sensitivity check. Secondary models and datasets are separated from the headline experiment and do not invalidate its constant variables.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the substantial increase in ASR with longer suffixes, saturation around 70–100 tokens, or the resulting diminishing returns and efficiency tradeoff.
